seo.title: Hybrid Command | Kain Universal Web System
seo.description: The full-spectrum Kain web archetype that mixes business launch, portfolio proof, immersive scene staging, chat, docs search, forms, and actor routes.

hero.title: One Kain starter for the full website stack.
hero.body: Hybrid Command is the kitchen-sink archetype: business messaging, portfolio proof, 3D staging, docs/search, chat, intake, and actor-backed local runtime all live in one manifest-driven system.

feature_cards.title: Launch surfaces
feature_cards.body: Hero, proof, pricing, FAQ, docs, and intake come prewired.

feature_cards.title: 3D staging

feature_cards.title: Actor-ready local server
feature_cards.body: Search, chat, route docs, form capture, and health endpoints ship together.

blueprints.title: Manifest registries
blueprints.body: Themes, content, scenes, and experiences expand through data instead of copied app code.

blueprints.title: Node FFI web lane
blueprints.body: Serving, chat, search, and form capture stay outside Cargo while Kain remains the orchestrator.

blueprints.title: Semantic UI preview
blueprints.body: Kain UI still owns the native preview surface and design intent loop.

auth.title: Auth flows stay in the template contract.
auth.body: The universal pack now carries sign-in, invite, and membership strategy metadata as first-class site data instead of hiding it in page-specific code.
auth.session_body: The web runtime includes a dev-only cookie session so uploads, chat, and operator lanes can bind identity without a provider yet.

faq_items.question: Why keep one hybrid archetype?
answer: It is the proving ground for the whole website system.
Use it to test content, scene, search, chat, and actor surfaces together before specializing.

faq_items.question: Does this still avoid Rust?
answer: Yes. The end-user runtime path stays on Node while Kain owns the orchestrating entrypoints.
